messages:
zoe: Hi all, first day questions: MDM installer on my personal Mac errors with 'Profile signature invalid'. VPN connects but can't reach internal docs (403). Also I need temporary KMS read for a spike. Who do I ask to expedite?

people-ops: Welcome @zoe! Tag it-support for enrollment/VPN, security for KMS/phish.

it-support: Hi Zoe 1: For 'Profile signature invalid' try deleting any existing Redwood profiles: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Profiles, then reboot and re-run the installer. If that doesn't fix it, run `log show --predicate 'subsystem CONTAINS "mdm"' --last 30m` and paste output. For VPN/403, check that Okta device approval is complete and that your VPN client is the company build (we block older clients). Run `curl -I https://docs.internal.redwood` and paste response.

security: KMS read access is via the key-request form: https://redwood.example/internal/key-requests. For short-lived access use the Dev Portal ephemeral tokens: https://devtools.redwood.internal/ephemeral (choose scope kms:read, ttl 1h). If you file a key-request and need expedite, paste the request ID here and we'll prioritize. Phish sim is mandatory and runs for 14 days; check for emails from training@phishsim.io.

security-bot: Reminder: Complete security onboarding (SEC101) within 10 days: https://learn.redwood.ai/courses/sec101

zoe: Thanks. I removed old profiles and reinstalled  installer still reports signature error. Attached output: `log show --predicate 'subsystem CONTAINS "mdm"' --last 30m | tail -n 40` shows "Profile verification failed: signature mismatch". I filed key-request (KR-9912) with manager approval. Can someone expedite KR-9912? Also VPN `curl -I` returned 403, Okta shows device approved.

it-support: KR-9912 is noted for expedite by security once you paste the request link (we need the full URL). For the MDM error, please try manual install: `sudo profiles install -F ~/Downloads/redwood-mdm.mobileconfig` then `profiles status -type enrollment`. If that fails, collect the installer pkg receipt and mdm logs and DM them to us. For VPN 403 we saw a recent ACL change; try reconnecting and then `ssh zoe@staging-jump.redwood.internal` to verify routing. If that fails, we'll open a temporary route.

security: Got KR-9912 (link updated) 1. Marked for expedited review. We'll provision ephemeral kms:read for 2 hours while we complete review. Expect an email with instructions in ~15m.

zoe: Amazing, thank you 1! I'll try the manual install and test the jumpbox once the ephemeral creds arrive.

people-ops: Welcome again 1 1 Ping this thread if anything blocks onboarding.
